name: Enter the Void (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 15, Path of the Ravaging Void

Benefit: The nightblade’s elemental shade creates a dark void in its center, drawing enemies towards it. Creatures within the area of the nightblade’s elemental shade have their movement speed cut in half (no save). An enemy within the area of the nightblade’s elemental shade that tries to move away from the center must succeed on a bull rush combat maneuver check against a CMD of 10 + the nightblade’s level + her Charisma modifier, done as part of the move action. If it succeeds, it can move as normal (though still at half speed). On a failed save, the creature’s move action is wasted and it does not move. If the creature fails by 10 or more, it is pulled 5 feet closer to the center of the elemental shade.
